description.narrative: Quinto Elemento Lab is a nonprofit, nonpartisan, and independent organization in Mexico that promotes investigative journalism to promote citizen participation in matters of public interest, providing citizens with information that reinforces democratic practices. Quinto Elemento Lab aims to increase the consistency, quality, and reach of the investigations it supports while diversifying the formats and dissemination channels to reach underserved audiences. As with all Hewlett grants supporting journalism, this grant maintains the editorial independence of the recipient organization.
